paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages (%) achieved by different models in detecting misinformation across various conditions. The horizontal axis lists the categories: “Our”, “W/o select”, “W/o text”, “W/o cognition”, and “W/o emotion”, ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 75.0% to 95.0%, with the label “Accuracy (%)”. The scale is linear, with tick intervals of 5 percentage points. The bars are colored blue, with the height of each bar corresponding to the accuracy percentage for that category and condition. The bar for “Our” W/o comments has a value of 86.82%, while the tallest bar, “Our” W/o emotion, reaches a value of 90.57%. The bar for “W/o text” has a value of 84.91%, with the shortest bar, “W/o select”, having a value of 83.02%.  There are no bars that are visually emphasized, and the chart is not sorted in any particular order.
